# Registration Report
```{python}
#| output: False
from FISCAS_Validator import Validator, CellType
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import random
from IPython.display import HTML, display, SVG

def convert_to_float_and_round(value, decimal=4):
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [convert_to_float_and_round(item) for item in value]
    elif isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return np.array([convert_to_float_and_round(item) for item in value])
    else:
        return round(float(value), decimal)
```

if seed == 0:
    seed = random.randint(1, 10000)

                mass_list[1] : ["normal", 25, 5],
                mass_list[2] : ["normal", 15, 5],
                mass_list[3] : ["uniform", 0, 0]

                mass_list[1] : ["uniform", 0, 0],

noise_scale=noise_scale,
seed=seed,
plot=plot,

texture=texture,

diffusion_leaky_outer_boundary=diffusion_leaky_outer_boundary)
canvas_metrics, registration_metrics, segmentation_metrics, spectra_metrics = A.main()
mass_list = A.mass_list
filename = f"{output}/spectra_hist_{mass_list[0]}.svg"

## Settings
```{python}
settings = A.return_settings()
html_table = pd.DataFrame(list(settings.items()), columns=['Key', 'Value']).to_html(index=False)
display(HTML(html_table))

cell_types = A.cell_types
for cell_type in cell_types:
    name = cell_type.name
    population = cell_type.population
    parameters = cell_type.parameters
    cell_type_table = pd.DataFrame(parameters.values(), columns=["distribution", "location", "scale"])
    cell_type_table.insert(0, "m/z", A.mass_list)
    print(f"Cell Type {name} makes up {population*100}% of the total cell population")
    display(HTML(cell_type_table.to_html(index=False)))
```

## Spectra Compilation

::: {layout="[[45,-10,45],[100]]"}

![Spectra Compilation Histogram](`{python} filename`){#fig-spectra_hist}

![FPR Histogram](./output/fpr_hist.svg){#fig-fpr_hist}

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame(list(spectra_metrics.items()), columns=['Key', 'Value'])
df2 = pd.DataFrame(df.loc[~df['Key'].isin(["time", "FPR"]), 'Value'].to_list(), columns=[mz for mz in mass_list])
df2 = df2.fillna(0)
df2.insert(0, 'Metric', df.loc[~df['Key'].isin(["time", "FPR"]), 'Key'].to_list())
for mz in mass_list:
    df2[mz] = df2[mz].apply(convert_to_float_and_round, decimal=2)
html_table = df2.to_html(index=False)
display(HTML(html_table))
print(f"mean FPR is {spectra_metrics['FPR']:.2f}% \nSpectra compilation took {spectra_metrics['time']} s")
```
